config firewall vip
    edit "netops-firewall-services-679-vip"
        set uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
        set extip 192.0.2.179
        set mappedip "192.0.2.20"
        set extintf "host01"
        set arp-reply disable
        set portforward enable
        set extport 43679
        set mappedport 54679
    next
end
